dict.string: Flotilla listens while you dictate a message to a bot or text to type on your computer.
Flotilla turns what you dictate into text. It stays on this iPhone when your language supports on-device recognition.
Flotilla asks for Face ID before it publishes or confirms a ruling that gives a bot more permissions.
Flotilla scans the pairing code your computer shows, to connect to it, and takes photos you attach to a new board item.
Flotilla connects to the Flotilla service on your computer, over your own network or tailnet.
